hook: Anastasis Germanidis studied computer science at Wesleyan University before working as a backend engineer at Quantcast and Chartbeat. He then worked as a machine learning researcher in computer vision at IBM Research while completing a master's degree at NYU's Interactive Telecommunications Program. In 2018 he co-founded Runway with Cristóbal Valenzuela, building tools that brought machine learning models into creative video and image workflows for filmmakers and designers. As the company's research lead he helped drive its successive generative video models, including Gen-1, Gen-2, Gen-3 Alpha, and Gen-4, with Gen-3 Alpha named one of TIME's 100 Best Inventions of 2024. He has since expanded his role to Co-CEO alongside his continued work directing Runway's research.
